verdict.rationale: Requesty lets you create service accounts for non-human entities, with keys whose spend is not tied to any user. Each API key or service account can have its own monthly spend cap, so an agent can get a dedicated, budget-capped key and cannot run away on spend. missing for 10: evidence of per-key request or rate limits (only a monthly spend cap is documented), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the caps are enforced.
